question: Can a public-reference facade fingerprint confirm the user-named physical entity without any OCR observation, and reject every other admitted goal?

source.authority: Wikidata supplies public entity identity and coordinates; Wikimedia Commons supplies public reference images. A pre-inference visual source audit admits only entities with a wide or contextual view, an entrance or on-site identity view, and at least one disjoint additional view.
source.claim_scope: Six real Hong Kong named entities with public-reference images; source-curated Development evidence, not citywide, natural-video, metric-arrival, product, user-benefit, or safety evidence.

role_freeze.indexing: One-based reference_images order in the frozen target library.

excluded_entities.hong-kong-central-library: Fewer than four views with a stable facade, entrance, or navigational identity carrier.
excluded_entities.hkcec: Firework and haze frames do not provide stable current-frame entity evidence.
excluded_entities.international-finance-centre: Two portrait/event frames leave fewer than four stable entity views.
excluded_entities.times-square-hong-kong: Event imagery does not separate the venue from temporary content strongly enough for source truth.

role_freeze.negative_goals: For every query, all five other admitted entity identities are evaluated as wrong goals; no hard-negative selection uses model output.

arms.name_only: CLIP image-to-public-name similarity. It uses no OCR and no reference image.
arms.global_reference: 0.55 * maximum CLIP reference similarity + 0.45 * maximum pooled DINOv2 reference similarity.
arms.facade_fingerprint: 0.35 * maximum CLIP reference similarity + 0.25 * maximum pooled DINOv2 reference similarity + 0.40 * maximum mutual-patch affine-consistency score.

geometry.score: mean mutual similarity * (0.5 + 0.5 * affine inlier ratio) * min(1, match_count / 12)

decision.candidate_score: goal score minus the strongest other admitted entity score
decision.threshold: For each arm, choose the non-negative threshold with maximum balanced accuracy on the frozen calibration positives and all calibration wrong-goal pairs; break ties toward the larger threshold.
decision.confirm: Confirm only when the user goal wins the entity roster and its calibrated margin reaches threshold; otherwise return UNKNOWN/KEEP_SEARCHING.
decision.ocr_policy: No OCR engine or OCR-derived observation is called in this experiment. OCR remains an independent future evidence branch, never the sole identity authority.

primary_metrics: wrong-goal false-confirmation count across every other admitted entity
stop_condition: Run the frozen evaluation once. Retain local geometry only if facade_fingerprint improves top-1 retrieval over global_reference without increasing wrong-goal false confirmations; otherwise localize the missing information source and do not tune this cohort.
